item.title: CISA Releases White Paper “CVE Program: Establishing a Quality Era Framework”
item.description: CISA Releases White Paper “CVE Program: Establishing a Quality Era Framework”newsSeptember 24, 2026Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)has released a new white paper, “CVE Program: Establishing a Quality Era Framework,” describing the next phase ofCVE™ Programmaturation. As the CVE ecosystem continues to expand globally and vulnerability volumes rise, the paper emphasizes a renewed focus on reliability, responsiveness, and vulnerability data quality.

item.title: The CVE Program’s Quality Era: Modernizing the CVE Program Automation Support System
item.description: The CVE Program’s Quality Era: Modernizing the CVE Program Automation Support SystemblogBy CVE Program|September 24, 2026Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency’s (CISA)recent “CVE Program: Establishing a Quality Era Framework,” white paper describes how theCVE™ Programis evolving to keep pace with a rapidly changing vulnerability landscape. That publication introduced the four major dimensions of quality and outlined CISA’s strategic lines of effort for a “Quality Era” focused on reliability, responsiveness, and better vulnerability data.

item.title: SafeSource Lab Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: SafeSource Lab Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsSeptember 29, 2026SafeSource Labis now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for all SafeSource Lab products only. This includes the SafeSource vulnerability management platform, the SafeSource digital security compliance platform, and any other software products developed and maintained by SafeSource Lab. The scope covers vulnerabilities in SafeSource Lab products discovered internally or reported to SafeSource Lab by third parties. Vulnerabilities in third-party products, or in components not developed or maintained by SafeSource Lab, are not included in this scope.

item.title: CNAs — Register Now for “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” on October 29, 2026
item.description: CNAs — Register Now for “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” on October 29, 2026blogBy CVE Program|October 6, 2026The CVE Program will host a “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” virtual event forCVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs)on Thursday, October 29, 2026, from 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM EDT (UTC-4).This CNA workshop is free, but registration is required. Information on how to register was sent directly to CNAs on September 3, with reminder emails sent on September 17 and October 5. Note that registration closes at 11:59 PM EDT on October 23, 2026.

item.title: CVE Program Data Registry: Automating Federated Management
item.description: CVE Program Data Registry: Automating Federated ManagementblogBy CVE Program|October 6, 2026Over the past decade, theCVE™ Programhas expanded globally to include more than 550 collaborating organizations, withCVE Recordpublication increasingly federated across this community. Participation is expected to continue to expand. As this growth accelerates, the need to distribute management functions efficiently across program participants is more critical than ever.
